downstream_reviews.snippet: 1.1 **The definitions agree and the cavity conclusions apply.** The class $X$, the subspace $V$ and the space $H$ of the Statement are exactly those of [L1] for the same domain $\Omega$: the same graph-norm closure of the same smooth fields on the closure with $\nu\times u=0$, the same divergence-free subspace and the same closed $L^2$ span, and the Axiom of Choice assumed in the Statement is the choice assumption of [L1], whose meaning is fixed by [L5].
